summary: Focused UI/UX implementation guide for MT5 Basic (EA-bridge self-hosted) vs MT5 Managed (MetaApi cloud zero-terminal setup) plans, credential disclosures, upgrade flows, deployment telemetry, and Admin MT5 controls while maintaining the high-density trading terminal aesthetic.

typography.font_heading: Barlow Condensed, Space Grotesk, Manrope, sans-serif
typography.font_body: Inter, IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif
typography.font_mono: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace

entry_surfaces./mt5: Dense dual-panel terminal — Active tier indicator & 2-tier plan comparison top, EA bridge setup OR MetaApi cloud provisioner form center, Live telemetry & Survival Mode controls right
entry_surfaces./subscribe: High-contrast pricing matrix with signal subscription prerequisite banner, MT5 Basic EA self-hosted tier vs MT5 Managed MetaApi 0-setup tier
entry_surfaces./admin: Command center data table with MetaApi server health indicator, active account provision states, and dynamic plan pricing/duration controls

basic_tier.title: MT5 Basic (Self-Hosted EA)
basic_tier.cost: Included in standard MT5 Auto-Trading pricing
basic_tier.workflow: User installs MT5 terminal on Windows/VPS, compiles UniversalTerminalBridge.mq5, attaches EA with token & bridge URL

managed_tier.title: MT5 Managed (Zero-Terminal MetaApi Cloud)
managed_tier.workflow: User enters MT5 Login, Password, Broker Server, Account Mode (Live/Demo). Plaintext password sent directly to MetaApi provisioning API over HTTPS and immediately discarded. Server stores only MetaApi account IDs.

upgrade_policy.existing_users_migration: Existing MT5 Auto-Trading subscribers migrate to MT5 Basic with all remaining entitlement days preserved intact.
upgrade_policy.upgrade_rule: Full-price upgrade (₹2,999 for 30 days) with no prorated/unused-time deduction. Instant activation of Cloud Deployment slot.

security_disclosure.disclosure_copy: Zero Plaintext Storage Guarantee: Your MT5 credentials are transmitted over encrypted TLS directly to our isolated MetaApi cloud deployment pod and purged immediately from server memory. We only retain your provisioning account ID and read-only telemetry handle.
security_disclosure.visual_treatment: Dedicated emerald-tinted security callout (`bg-[#052E16] border-[#166534]`) with ShieldCheck icon and lock badge next to the credential inputs.

plan_comparison_card_grid.basic_card: border border-slate-800 bg-[#111722] rounded-lg p-5 flex flex-col justify-between relative
plan_comparison_card_grid.managed_card: border-2 border-sky-500/60 bg-[#0D2338]/80 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(2,132,199,0.15)] rounded-lg p-5 flex flex-col justify-between relative
plan_comparison_card_grid.managed_badge: absolute -top-3 right-4 bg-sky-500 text-white font-mono text-[11px] font-bold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded uppercase tracking-wider shadow-sm

managed_credentials_form.container: bg-[#111722] border border-slate-800 rounded-lg p-6 space-y-4

badges.tier_badge: bg-slate-800 text-sky-400 font-mono text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-slate-700
badges.metaapi_status: flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded

survival_mode_toggle.title: Survival Mode Guard
survival_mode_toggle.description: Dynamic volatility-based lot dampening & equity protection active for both Basic and Managed tiers.

admin_mt5_controls.pricing_editor: Admin modal/card to adjust MT5 Basic price, MT5 Managed price (₹2,999 default), duration days (30 default), and availability toggle
admin_mt5_controls.metaapi_health_indicator: Read-only system status chip displaying MetaApi Provisioning API reachability, active cloud accounts count, and latency.

motion_and_interactions.managed_glow: animate-pulse duration-1000 for cloud provisioning synchronization

accessibility_and_compliance.wcag_contrast: All text tokens meet AA 4.5:1 minimum on dark base (#0B0E14) and panel (#111722)
accessibility_and_compliance.input_accessibility: All inputs include explicit <Label> with htmlFor matching input id, clear aria-describedby for password security guarantees

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Preserve the existing dark tactical terminal aesthetic in /frontend/src/pages/Mt5.tsx and Admin panels.
2. On /mt5, render a top tier comparison banner showing MT5 Basic vs MT5 Managed (₹2,999/30d) with distinct visual hierarchies.
3. If the user is on MT5 Basic, show the EA download + Bridge token tab, with an 'Upgrade to Managed Cloud (₹2,999)' instant action.
4. If the user has MT5 Managed entitlement, show the streamlined 'Zero-Terminal Setup' credential form with the Security Guarantee banner prominently rendered above the inputs.
5. Ensure Demo and Live accounts can both be selected in the managed form.
6. Show real-time MetaApi connection status (Provisioning, Connected, Synchronized, Error) alongside existing balance/equity metrics.
7. Ensure Survival Mode settings and status are available for both Basic and Managed accounts.
8. In the Admin panel, provide controls to edit pricing, duration, and view read-only MetaApi configuration status.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.layout: Avoid generic centered layouts. Use dense data-forward grids with high contrast typography.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.buttons: Use tactical sharp or pill buttons with explicit hover and active states (never transparent or generic).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.icons: Use lucide-react (e.g. ShieldCheck, CloudLightning, Terminal, Server, ArrowUpRight, Zap, RefreshCw). Never emojis for UI icons.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous breathing room between dense widgets (p-5 or p-6 for panels, gap-4 for grids).
